items.example: Sorry to interrupt, but could you repeat the date of the meeting?
Excuse me, I don't think I understood the last part.
Can I just say something? I've been to that restaurant and it's very good.
Hold on a moment, I think we're talking about different days.

note.en: Direct; fine between friends or colleagues.
note.es: Directo; vale entre amigos o compañeros.

items.phrase: Sorry, may I just add something?
items.example: Sorry, may I just add something? The price includes the guided tour.
Can I come in here? I had exactly the same problem with that app.

items.phrase: Sorry, could I just stop you there?
items.example: Sorry, could I just stop you there? I'm not sure that figure is correct.
Before you go on, can I ask how long the course lasts?
If I might just interject, the committee has already approved that budget.

note.en: Very polite; suits meetings and presentations.
note.es: Muy educado; adecuado para reuniones y presentaciones.

items.example: Pardon the interruption, but the next speaker is waiting outside.

items.phrase: I hate to cut in, but …
items.example: I hate to cut in, but we're running out of time.

items.phrase: May I raise a point here?
items.example: May I raise a point here? The survey only covers people under thirty.
Sorry, what time is the meeting?
Wait, I don't understand. Can you say that again?
